an3.60:1.1: Atha kho Saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami . . .
an3.60:1.2: pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno Saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.60:1.3: Mayam assu bho Gotama brāhmaṇā nāma
an3.60:1.5: Tatra bho Gotama yo c' eva yajati yo ca yajāpeti sabbe te anekasārīrikaṃ puññapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā honti yadidaṃ yaññādhikaraṇaṃ.
an3.60:1.6: Yo panāyaṃ bho Gotama yassa vā tassa vā kulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ekam attānaṃ dameti ekam attānaṃ sameti ekam attānaṃ parinibbāpeti. Evam assāyaṃ ekasārīrikaṃ puññapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇan ti.
an3.60:2.1: Tena hi brāhmaṇa taṃ yev' ettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
an3.60:2.3: Idha Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā.
an3.60:2.5: ethāyaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā yathā paṭipanno aham anuttaraṃ brahmacariyogadhaṃ sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedemi.
an3.60:2.6: Etha tumhe pi tathā paṭipajjatha yathā paṭipannā tumhe pi anuttaraṃ brahmacariyogadhaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā ti.
an3.60:2.7: Iti ayaṃ c' eva satthā dhammaṃ deseti pare ca tathattāya paṭipajjanti. Tāni kho pana honti anekāni pi satāni anekāni pi sahassāni anekāni pi satasahassāni.
an3.60:3.2: Iccāyaṃ evaṃ sante ekasārīrikā vā puññapaṭipadā hoti anekasārīrikā vā yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇan ti?
an3.60:3.3: Iccāyam pi bho Gotama evaṃ sante anekasārīrikā puññapaṭipadā hoti yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇan ti. 2.
an3.60:4.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇam etad avoca:--
an3.60:4.2: Imāsaṃ te brāhmaṇa dvinnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamā paṭipadā khamati appaṭṭhatarā ca appasamārambhatarā ca mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā cā ti?
an3.60:4.3: Evaṃ vutte Saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.60:4.4: Seyyathāpi bhavaṃ Gotamo bhavañ c' Ānando
an3.60:4.5: ete me pujjā ete me pāsaṃsā ti.
an3.60:5.1: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.60:5.2: Na kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa evaṃ pucchāmi
an3.60:5.3: -ke vā te pujjā ke vā te pāsaṃsā ti. Evañ
an3.60:5.5: imāsaṃ te brāhmaṇa dvinnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamā paṭipadā khamati appaṭṭhatarā ca appasamārambhatarā ca mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā cā ti?
an3.60:5.6: Dutiyam pi kho Saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.60:5.7: Seyyathāpi bhavaṃ Gotamo bhavañ c' Ānando
an3.60:5.8: ete me pujjā ete me pāsaṃsā ti.
an3.60:6.1: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.60:6.2: Na kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa evaṃ pucchāmi --
an3.60:6.3: ke vā te pujjā ke vā te pāsaṃsā ti. Evañ
an3.60:6.5: imāsan te brāhmaṇa dvinnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamā paṭipadā khamati appaṭṭhatarā ca appasamārambhatarā ca mahāpphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā cā ti?
an3.60:6.6: Tatiyam pi kho Saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.60:6.7: Seyyathāpi bhavaṃ Gotamo bhavañ c' Ānando
an3.60:6.8: ete me pujjā ete me pāsaṃsā ti. 3.
an3.60:7.2: Yāva tatiyam pi kho Saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo Ānandena sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti no vissajjeti,
an3.60:7.4: Atha kho Bhagavā Saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca.
an3.60:7.5: Kā nu 'jja brāhmaṇa rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ antarā kathā udapādī ti?
an3.60:7.6: Ayaṃ khvajja bho Gotama rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ antarā kathā udapādi
an3.60:7.7: -Pubbassudaṃ appatarā c' eva bhikkhū ahesuṃ bahutarā ca uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassesuṃ,
an3.60:7.8: etarahi kho bahutarā c' eva bhikkhū appatarā ca uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassentī ti.
an3.60:7.9: Ayaṃ khvajja bho Gotama rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ antarā kathā udapādī ti. 4.
an3.60:8.5: Idha brāhmaṇa ekacco anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti -- eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhā pi hutvā eko hoti, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ, tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno va gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse, paṭhaviyā pi ummujja-nimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake, udake pi abhijjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ, ākāse pi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhisakuṇo, ime pi candimasuriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati parimajjati, yāva brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
an3.60:9.3: evam pi te mano ittham pi te mano iti pi te cittan ti.
an3.60:9.4: So bahuñ ce pi ādisati, tath' eva taṃ hoti no aññathā.
an3.60:10.1: Idha pana brāhmaṇa ekacco na h' eva kho nimittena ādisati, api ca kho manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati,
an3.60:10.2: evam pi te mano ittham pi te mano iti pi te cittan ti.
an3.60:10.3: So bahuñ ce pi ādisati tath' eva taṃ hoti no aññathā.
an3.60:11.1: Idha pana brāhmaṇa ekacco na h' eva kho nimittena ādisati na pi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati,
an3.60:11.2: evam pi kho te mano ittham pi te mano iti pi te cittan ti.
an3.60:11.3: So bahuñ ce pi ādisati tath' eva taṃ hoti no aññathā.
an3.60:12.1: Idha pana brāhmaṇa ekacco na h' eva kho nimittena ādisati na pi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati na pi vitakkayato na pi vicārayato na vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisat, api ca kho avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa citasā ceto paricca pajānāti,
an3.60:12.2: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhāre paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amun nāma vitakkaṃ vitakkissatī ti.
an3.60:12.3: So bahuñ ce pi ādisati tath' eva taṃ hoti no aññathā.
an3.60:13.3: Evaṃ vitakketha mā evaṃ vitakkayittha, evaṃ manasikarotha mā evaṃ manasākattha, idaṃ pajahatha idaṃ upasampajja viharathā ti.
an3.60:13.6: Imesan te brāhmaṇa tiṇṇaṃ pāṭihāriyānaṃ katamaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ khamati abhikkantatarañ ca paṇītatarañ cā ti?
an3.60:14.1: Tatra bho Gotama yaṃ idaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ -- idh' ekacco anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti . . . pe . . .
an3.60:14.3: idaṃ bho Gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ yo ca naṃ karoti so ca naṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, yo ca naṃ karoti tassa c' eva taṃ hoti.
an3.60:14.4: Idam eva bho Gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ māyāsahadhammarūpaṃ viya khāyati.
an3.60:15.1: Yam pi idaṃ bho Gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ -- idh'
an3.60:15.3: ekacco nimittena ādisati . . . pe . . . devatānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā . . . pe . . .
an3.60:15.6: pe . . . idam pi bho Gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ yo ca naṃ karoti so ca
an3.60:15.7: naṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, yo ca naṃ karoti tassa c' eva taṃ hoti.
an3.60:15.8: Idam pi bho Gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ māyāsahadhammarūpaṃ viya khāyati.
an3.60:16.1: Yañ ca kho idaṃ bho Gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ -- idh' ekacco evaṃ anusāsati . . .
an3.60:16.3: bho Gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ khamati imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ pāṭihāriyānaṃ abhikkantatarañ ca paṇītatarañ ca.
an3.60:17.1: Acchariyaṃ bho Gotama abbhutaṃ bho Gotama
an3.60:17.2: yāva subhāsitaṃ c' idaṃ bhotā Gotamena. Imehi ca mayaṃ tīhi pāṭihāriyehi samannāgataṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dhārema.
an3.60:17.3: Bhavañ hi Gotamo anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti . . . pe . . . yāva brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
an3.60:17.4: Bhavañ hi Gotamo avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti
an3.60:17.5: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amun nāma vitakkaṃ vitakkissatī ti.
an3.60:17.7: evaṃ vitakketha mā evaṃ vitakkayittha evaṃ manasikarotha mā evaṃ manasākattha idaṃ pajahatha idaṃ upasampajja viharathā ti. 7.
an3.60:18.1: Addhā kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa āsajja upanīya-vācā bhāsitā,
an3.60:18.3: hi brāhmaṇa anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhomi . . . pi . . . yāva brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vattemi.
an3.60:18.4: Ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi
an3.60:18.5: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amun nāma vitakkaṃ vitakkissatī ti.
an3.60:18.7: evaṃ vitakketha mā evaṃ vitakkayittha evaṃ manasikarotha mā evaṃ manasākattha idaṃ pajahatha idaṃ upasampajja viharathā ti.
an3.60:19.1: Atthi pana bho Gotama añño ekabhikkhu pi yo imehi tīhi pāṭihāriyehi samannāgato aññatra bhotā Gotamenā ti?
an3.60:19.2: Na kho brāhmaṇa ekaṃ yeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni atha kho bhiyyo va ye bhikkhū imehi tīhi pāṭihāriyehi samannāgatā ti.
an3.60:19.3: Kahaṃ pana bho Gotama etarahi te bhikkhū viharantī ti?
an3.60:19.4: Imasmiṃ yeva kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhusaṅghe ti.
an3.60:20.1: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama.
an3.60:20.2: Seyyathāpi bho Gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam eva bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an3.60:20.3: Esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca.
an3.60:20.4: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotama dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. 61. 1.
